decisions.reason: The existing same-message CAD modification captures the solenoid layout but omits the accepted custom-fabricated stainless-steel spout matching the supplied rendering.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Go ahead with that approach, and please match the rendering as closely as possible; I really like both its appearance and functionality. I do want one change from the rendering: move the plate labeled "Elena's Chai Whisk" from the back of the machine to the front. The spout and mixers will face the baristas, while customers will view the machine from another angle, so the "Elena's Chai Whisk" plate needs to face the customer.

value_updates.layout_constraint: Represent custom-fabricated stainless-steel spouts matching the supplied rendering, with the solenoid valve directly beneath each bowl as part of the button-controlled dispensing path.
